g.text: 4 × 32k tokens × 32 KiB (bf16) = 1 × 256k tokens × 16 KiB (FP8) = 4.0 GiB of KV

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Only the 8 full-attention visits keep KV for the whole context (layer 5, layers 11 and 17 in each of the 3 loop passes, layer 23): 8 visits × 8 KV heads × 128 × (K, V) per token. The 40 sliding-window

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: visits keep a ring of 1088 positions per slot, whatever the context length.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Totals measured on the RTX PRO 6000 proxy with a 32 GiB cap (tests/gpu/memcheck.py, tests/gpu/longctx.py; docs/benchmarks.md). Segments computed from the checkpoint’s tensor sizes and cache.py; the

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: dashed segment is the measured total minus them.
